counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of characteristic discoid lupus erythematosus lesions with follicular plugging
Absence of specific autoantibodies in R3
Lack of systemic symptoms in R3
decisive_items: Symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques on the cheeks and temples
Positive: anti-Smith antibodies, SSA/Ro antibodies, SSB/La antibodies, and anti-U1RNP antibodies
response.rationale: R1 is the champion because it has more specific and detailed support from the vignette, including the presence of symmetric annular brown erythematous plaques and positive anti-SSA/Ro antibodies, which are characteristic of Subacute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus. R3 is the runner-up because it also has some support from the vignette, but it lacks the specificity and detail of R1.

rejected.why: R2 lacks specific support from the vignette and its championing assessments are not as detailed or specific as those of R1 and R3.
